episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.synopsis: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar takes up residence in Los Angeles where he helps Detective Chloe Decker solve the murder of a pop star.

episodes.title: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
episodes.synopsis: Lucifer and Chloe work together to solve the murder of a paparazzo who caused the death of a movie star's son.

episodes.title: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
episodes.synopsis: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback finds a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to Lucifer for help.

episodes.title: Manly Whatnots
episodes.synopsis: Lucifer seeks Chloe's advice on seduction after a girl rejects his charms, while they investigate a missing person case.

episodes.title: Sweet Kicks
episodes.synopsis: Lucifer seduces a high-end shoe designer while investigating a fatal shooting at an underground streetwear fashion show.
